pairs.subject: retry-backoff
pairs.evidence: lib/ingest/sources/refusal-class.ts:54 The classifier defaults novel or unrecognised non-ok HTTP responses to the permanent declined class instead of an unknown class with conservative retries and rate monitoring, permanently dropping recoverable requests.

techniques.evidence: lib/ingest/sources/backoff.ts:24 Computes exponential backoff clamped to capMs with full jitter drawn uniformly from [0, ceiling].
lib/ingest/sources/pumper.ts:70 Direct HTTP calls lack circuit breaker protection to track consecutive failures, enter cooldown, or probe recovery.
lib/ingest/sources/pumper.ts:72 Client fails immediately on non-ok status without schedule stop values and does not enforce single-redirect bounds or scheme downgrade checks.
lib/ingest/sources/pumper.ts:199 Dataset mirror passes execute in memory without persisting attempt counts, next retry-at schedules, or terminal states across restarts.
lib/ingest/sources/refusal-class.ts:54 Fallback branch classifies unknown non-ok status codes as declined (permanent) rather than unknown, and ignores response headers like Retry-After.
lib/ingest/sources/refusal-class.ts:67 Terminal failures format an error string but emit no structured per-item attempt histories, distinct terminal states, or attempts-per-success metrics.
lib/ingest/sources/backoff.ts:11 Per-attempt exponential backoff caps individual rungs but lacks aggregate fleet retry budgets, cross-item caps, or warn-once latching.
lib/ingest/sources/pumper.ts:71 Blocked or failed requests immediately throw rather than suspending attempts under unmet local conditions with stricter resumption predicates.

pairs.registryProposal: Consider noting in error-classification-for-retry that scraping adapters targeting rate-sensitive public civic infrastructure intentionally fail toward permanent refusal for unrecognised 4xx status codes to avoid triggering upstream IP bans.
